description: Is this brand offer fair? Give what the brand wants (deliverable, the creator's audience size, any usage rights, exclusivity or rush) and the amount they offered, and get where the offer sits against Selah's rate for that whole scope, how it compares with published rates, and a suggested counter-offer. Use for 'a brand offered me $400 for a Reel, is that fair', 'should I accept this offer', 'what should I counter with'. Needs a deliverable, an audience size and the offered amount: ask the creator for any that are missing rather than guessing. Does not review contracts, give legal or tax advice, find brands, or price UGC, affiliate or commission-only work. Amounts are in US dollars. No account needed.

audience_size.description: The creator's audience on the platform the deliverable is for: followers, subscribers or listeners

deliverable.description: What the brand wants: instagram_reel, instagram_post, instagram_story (a set), tiktok_video, youtube_integration (a mention inside a video), youtube_dedicated, podcast_mention, blog_post or newsletter_feature

exclusivity_months.description: Months the creator may not work with competitors. 0 or omitted = none

offered_amount.description: The total the brand offered for everything they're asking for, in US dollars

perpetual.description: The brand wants usage forever / in perpetuity

rush.description: The brand needs it faster than a normal turnaround

usage_months.description: How long the usage lasts, in months (30 days = 1, 90 days = 3). Defaults to 3 when usage_type is set and the brand named no term

usage_type.description: Usage rights the brand wants, if any. organic = the brand reposts it on their own pages; paid = the brand runs it as ads from their own account; whitelisting = ads run from the creator's handle (includes TikTok Spark Codes); ooh = out-of-home

name: selah_check_offer
title: Check a brand offer
